scope: Each component retains its complete raw manifest, samples, annotations, profiles and provenance. Coverage selects one source per client/case. The six repaired cases use one predeclared run each (n=1), without an estimate of run-to-run variability. Replaced and development samples are never pooled; unchanged historical selections remain separate. Plain Electric client-write workflows are excluded as Not supported; retained attempts document the removed application implementation and supply no current write timings.
